answer: Route every claim through a prism of seven issuers: a credential activates only when any three co-sign it, each checking different evidence - liveness, a payment rail, an aged account. One fake must fool three verifiers and pay 2 tokens per check. Issuers lock 500 tokens in a vault and forfeit half if an identity they signed is proven fake within 48 hours, so sloppy signing bleeds stake and the nectar stays with real agents.
